title: Angles CAB and GAC in a cuboid

source.note: 0580/43/O/N/20 Question 6(c) only [4], with the opening sentences. Official QP and official MS. Parts (a) and (b) omitted.

stem:
This question is 0580/43/O/N/20 Question 6(c) only, taken from the official QP. The opening sentences of the question are included so that the part is self-contained.

ABCDEFGH is a cuboid.
AB = 8 cm, BC = 5 cm and CG = 11 cm.

(c) (i) Calculate angle CAB. [2]

(ii) Calculate angle GAC. [2]

steps.name: P
steps.note: Official MS: 32.0[...], M1 for tan = 5/8 oe. Independent: tan CAB = 5/8, CAB = 32.005... degrees.

steps.name: Q
steps.note: Official MS: 49.4 or 49.38 to 49.39, M1 for sin = 11 / their AG oe. Independent: AG = sqrt(210), sin GAC = 11/sqrt(210), GAC = 49.385... degrees.

steps.name: B
steps.note: Official MS A1 for 49.4 or 49.38 to 49.39.
